reason: A DeepSeek Harness web-search provider that routes the built-in web_search tool through the Brave Search Web API and requires a Brave API key.

summaries.zh: 通过 Brave Search Web API 为 DeepSeek Harness 的 web_search 工具提供网页搜索结果。
summaries.en: Routes DeepSeek Harness web_search requests through the Brave Search Web API.

capabilities: Performs web searches through the Brave Search Web API
Uses a configured Brave API key
Provides search results to the DeepSeek Harness web_search capability
